resources.purpose: Regular and italic font files for map lettering. The standard uses Times New Roman.
resources.whenMissing: Use the system's installed Times New Roman. If it is not installed, use a metric-compatible open font such as Liberation Serif or Tinos, and tell the user which font was used.
resources.howToObtain: Times New Roman ships with Windows and macOS. Liberation Serif and Tinos are free under the SIL Open Font License.
resources.license: Times New Roman is licensed by Monotype. Not redistributable.

resources.purpose: A finished map drawn to the V32 standard, as PNG or PDF, for comparing artwork and composition at reference size.
resources.whenMissing: Work from the written standard in references/scenario-map-style.md, and ask the user to review the first render closely.
resources.howToObtain: Use a map you have already accepted as matching V32, or a PNG or PDF supplied by the skill author. Save it in this folder, or add a README.md that points to where it is kept.
resources.license: Scenario-specific artwork. Not shipped with the skill.
